pos.personaBrief: Milan was a dynamic side always creating space to progress upfield (Coaches' Voice) and pressed to regain the ball in the opponent's half, so it wanted the ball and control, not a counter-attacking stance.

pro.personaBrief: Short quick passes with five players ahead of the ball and a quite direct style, with fast attack after winning the ball high (Holding Midfield, Vice), but build-up started with the defenders.

est.personaBrief: A solid 4-4-2 where all players understood positional relationships, drilled via shadow football (Coaches' Voice, FIFA), yet interchangeable multi-purpose players and wide midfielders moving central (Bleacher Report).

lar.personaBrief: Compact central 4-4-2 forcing opponents wide, attacking with full-backs progressing and wide midfielders moving central; a man on each side but anyone could fill it (FIFA, Coaches' Voice).

blo.personaBrief: Collective pressing in the opponent's half, forwards pressing center-backs, extremely high line and offside trap, 25 m between lines (Coaches' Voice, Vice, FourFourTwo).

mar.personaBrief: Pure zonal marking, opposed man-marking and the sweeper (FIFA, Bleacher Report, Vice).

pla.personaBrief: A fixed system imposed on players through exhausting drills, 'the system was the leader', applied against any opponent (FourFourTwo, Coaches' Voice).

res.personaBrief: Wanted to win through an active, protagonist football that rejected catenaccio; a high line and pressing to the end, not shutting games down (statedView, Ancelotti in FIFA).

sis.personaBrief: The system was the leader that never got tired; everyone did the pressing work, and drilled organisation beat disorganised talent (FourFourTwo, FIFA 'five organised beat ten disorganised').

jog.personaBrief: Exhausting athletic preparation and pressing intensity, yet Sacchi said mind counts more than athletics and wanted ball-comfortable defenders and multi-purpose players.

bas.personaBrief: Berlusconi bought stars (Gullit, Van Basten, Rijkaard, Ancelotti, Donadoni) around homegrown Baresi, Maldini, Costacurta; titles won by seasoned, drilled players with little rotation; youth not a priority.

lid.personaBrief: Autocratic, strict disciplinarian and brutally hard taskmaster who fell out with Van Basten (Vice, Mannari), with equal rules for the egos.
